name: gorge-hollowjaw
setup: subwave.worldClock.setDayFraction(0.32); subwave.jumpTo({x: 2427, z: -1316, y: -640}); const c = subwave.renderer.camera; const sim = subwave.creatures; window.__pin=(window.__pin||0)+1; const tok=window.__pin; (function pin(){ if(window.__pin!==tok) return; const p=subwave.player; p.lampOn=true; p.oxygen=p.oxygenCapacity; let best=-1,bl=0; const live=sim.liveSlots(); for(let k=0;k<live.length;k++){const i=live[k]; if(sim.tier[i]<4) continue; if(sim.bodyLength[i]>bl){bl=sim.bodyLength[i];best=i;}} if(best>=0){ const tx=sim.posX[best],ty=sim.posY[best],tz=sim.posZ[best]; const vx=sim.velX[best],vz=sim.velZ[best]; const sp2=Math.hypot(vx,vz)||1; const sx=-vz/sp2, sz=vx/sp2; p.position[0]=tx+sx*30; p.position[1]=ty+5; p.position[2]=tz+sz*30; p.prevPosition.set(p.position); p.velocity.fill(0); const dx=tx-p.position[0], dy=ty-(p.position[1]+1.68), dz=tz-p.position[2]; const dd=Math.hypot(dx,dy,dz); const yy=Math.atan2(dx,-dz), pp=Math.asin(dy/dd); p.yaw=yy; p.pitch=pp; c.setEuler(yy,pp,0);} requestAnimationFrame(pin); })();

name: prowler-frondmaw
setup: subwave.worldClock.setDayFraction(0.32); subwave.jumpTo('kelp'); const c = subwave.renderer.camera; const sim = subwave.creatures; window.__pin=(window.__pin||0)+1; const tok=window.__pin; (function pin(){ if(window.__pin!==tok) return; const p=subwave.player; p.oxygen=p.oxygenCapacity; let best=-1,bd=1e9; const live=sim.liveSlots(); for(let k=0;k<live.length;k++){const i=live[k]; if(sim.tier[i]<2) continue; const dx=sim.posX[i]-p.position[0],dy=sim.posY[i]-p.position[1],dz=sim.posZ[i]-p.position[2]; const d=Math.hypot(dx,dy,dz); if(d<bd){bd=d;best=i;}} if(best>=0&&bd<160){ const tx=sim.posX[best],ty=sim.posY[best],tz=sim.posZ[best]; const dx=tx-p.position[0], dy=ty-(p.position[1]+1.68), dz=tz-p.position[2]; const dd=Math.hypot(dx,dy,dz); const yy=Math.atan2(dx,-dz), pp=Math.asin(dy/dd); p.yaw=yy; p.pitch=pp; c.setEuler(yy,pp,0);} requestAnimationFrame(pin); })();
